Please refer to the policy for full terms and conditions. EDM FAQs Q1: Why does my 2TB A93 show less capacity than advertised? A 2TB SSD contains 2,000,000,000,000 bytes, equivalent to approximately 1.82 TiB or 1,863 GiB. Some operating systems display binary values using TB or GB labels. This unit difference does not mean storage is missing. Formatting and system partitions can further reduce available space. Q2: What are the maximum speeds of the A93, and why might actual speeds be lower? The A93 offers sequential speeds of up to 7,400 MB/s read and 6,500 MB/s write. A compatible PCIe Gen4 x4 connection is required to approach these speeds. Performance varies by capacity, system configuration, firmware, workload, temperature, and available SLC cache. Compatible PCIe Gen3 systems can also use the drive, but at lower interface speeds. Q3: Is the A93 compatible with PS5, and does its heatsink fit? The A93 is designed for PS5 M.2 storage expansion and includes a pre-installed aluminum heatsink. The complete SSD measures 8.75mm in height, including the heatsink. Its maximum sequential read speed of 7,400 MB/s exceeds Sony’s recommended 5,500 MB/s. Update your PS5 system software and follow Sony’s installation instructions before use. Q4: Can I install the A93 in a laptop or a compact PC? Check that your device supports M.2 2280 PCIe NVMe SSDs and provides enough clearance for the complete 8.75mm-high drive, including its pre-installed heatsink. Some thin laptops cannot accommodate this height. SATA-only M.2 slots are not compatible. Check your device manufacturer’s specifications before purchasing. Q5: Does the A93 get hot or throttle during heavy workloads? The A93 can become warm during gaming or sustained transfers. Its aluminum heatsink and thermal pad help dissipate heat, but temperature and performance depend on workload, ambient temperature, and airflow. Thermal throttling may occur during prolonged heavy workloads; the heatsink does not guarantee throttle-free operation. bottom of page
